name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12
observations: Derived from the BLS period code M01-M12; NULL on annual-average rows, which carry period_id M13

name: period_id
description: BLS period code identifying the month or the annual average
observations: BLS period code as published. M01-M12 are months; M13 is the annual average BLS publishes in the same files, on which month is NULL

name: state_id
description: FIPS code of the state or territory the area belongs to
observations: Taken from the series catalogue's srd_code. NULL on census region and division rows, whose code 80 is not a state

name: county_id
description: FIPS code of the county, on county rows
observations: Read from characters 3 to 7 of the LAUS area code, and only on area type F. NULL on every other area type. Four Alaska census areas retired before the current county delineation (02201, 02232, 02261, 02280) appear in 1990-2019 and do not resolve against the directory

name: cbsa_id
description: CBSA code, on metropolitan and micropolitan area rows
observations: Read from characters 5 to 9 of the LAUS area code, and only on area types B and D. Metropolitan divisions and combined areas carry a code in the same position that is not a CBSA code, so they are NULL here and readable only from area_id

name: area_type_id
description: LAUS area type, from statewide down to towns and balance-of-state areas

name: area_id
observations: The only identifier that covers every area type. The first two characters name the kind of area: ST state, MT metropolitan, DV metropolitan division, MC micropolitan, CA combined, CN county, CS and CT cities and towns, PT part of a city, SA small labor market area, ID and IM interstate part, BS balance of state, RD census region or division

name: series_id
observations: Kept alongside the decomposed dimensions so a series can be looked up directly against BLS. Example: LASST060000000000003, the unemployment rate for California, seasonally adjusted

name: measure_id
observations: Unemployment rate, unemployment, employment, labor force, employment-population ratio, labor force participation rate, and civilian noninstitutional population share the value column

name: seasonal_adjustment
description: Whether the series is seasonally adjusted (S) or not seasonally adjusted (U)
observations: A dimension of the series, not a footnote: adjusted and unadjusted values for the same cell are different numbers and must never be mixed

name: value
description: Published value of the series for the period
observations: Units differ by row and are given in measurement_unit, so no single column-level unit applies. BLS prints - for an observation that was not published; those are NULL, not zero

name: measurement_unit
description: Unit the value is measured in
observations: Derived by Data Basis from the dimension that fixes the unit (data type for CES, measure for LAUS, rate-or-level for JOLTS); not published as a field by BLS

name: footnote_id
description: BLS footnote code attached to the observation
observations: NULL when the observation carries no footnote. Codes flag preliminary and revised values and, in 2025, observations missing because of the lapse in appropriations
